plain: Lying close to, or right next to, something else

webster.text: Lying near, close, or contiguous; bordering upon; as, a field adjacent to the highway.

example.quote: The inhabitants of the adjacent states would be affected by the depreciation of paper money, which would assuredly produce a dispute with those states.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 6, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
